q1.explanationZh: 第二段说只有雌蚊（female）会叮人，因为要用血来养它的卵。

q2.explanationZh: 第四段说蚊子更爱叮O型血的人。

evidence.quote: Mosquitoes prefer to bite people with blood Type O twice as much as those with Type A.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说雌蚊能从30米远的地方闻到我们的体味。

evidence.quote: They can sense our body odour from 30 metres away.

q4.explanationZh: 我们呼出二氧化碳，蚊子被它吸引，所以晚上在头边嗡嗡叫。

evidence.quote: When you breathe carbon dioxide out through your nose or mouth, mosquitoes will find you.
